name: Canonical model-to-tool control plane
head: 52cd6cf4cc312d9072d8e1ce1fefdc740d193a76

contracts.brain: Returns untrusted bounded proposals and receives no Hands or operating-system authority.
contracts.director: Strictly decodes, resolves identities, validates schemas, derives risk, checks scoped permissions/resources, supplies postconditions/recovery, checkpoints risky mutations and creates stable idempotency keys.
contracts.hands: Dispatches only registered capability-plus-route executors and accepts evidence rather than a self-declared verified Boolean.
contracts.eyes: Runs registered post-execution observers under the action deadline.
contracts.verifier: Derives completion only from matching Eyes observations whose observer identity differs from the Hands executor.

failClosedEvidence: unknown model fields and non-JSON arguments
expired, cross-task, missing, app-mismatched, origin-mismatched or path-out-of-scope permission grants
missing postconditions, observers, recovery or risky-mutation checkpoints
missing Hands executors and malformed executor evidence
timeouts, cancellation and ambiguous idempotency journal entries
missing, malformed, self-authored or mismatching observations
productionIntegration: src/lib/skills/governed-run.ts imports and validates every admitted legacy governed step through the canonical OcadeActionRequest boundary.
Existing TaskScope, work-session planning, recovery graph, executor registry, independent verifier and evidence-ledger behavior remains in place.
